notes.title: Game Update Announcement
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the latest update for our game, bringing enhanced visuals and smoother gameplay! Here’s what’s new:

1. Added 2K and 4K Resolution Options: Enjoy stunning HD visuals with newly supported 2K and 4K resolutions for a sharper, more immersive experience.
2. Optimized In-Game Scenes: Select environments have been redrawn with improved detail and precision, elevating the overall aesthetic.
3. Enhanced Animation Scenes: Certain animations have been refined for greater smoothness and sophistication, making every moment more captivating.

Thank you for your continued support! Dive in and experience the upgraded visuals today!

notes.title: Game Update Notes
notes.content:
Dear Players,
    We’re thrilled to share the latest update for our game, designed to enhance your gameplay and address community feedback. Below are the key changes:

Special Update
    We deeply apologize for the English content errors caused by staff mistake. We’ve extensively revised all English text to correct these issues. Our team is dedicated to ongoing corrections, adjustments, and optimizations to ensure the best possible experience. We regret any inconvenience this may have caused our players.

Update Details
1.Adjusted Task Difficulty and Added Hints: We’ve balanced task difficulty and introduced in-game hints to improve flow and optimize the gaming experience.
2.Bug Fixes: Fixed known bugs and refined error messages for a more stable and seamless experience.
3.Sound Effect Optimization: Upgraded select sound effects to create a more immersive audio environment.

 If you have any issues or feedback, please reach out to our official customer support team. Thank you for your unwavering support and understanding.
Best regards,
The Development Team

notes.title: Q1 2024 Update Preview
notes.content:
1-Thank you to all players for their support and encouragement of our game. We will continue to optimize the CG animation in the game, redraw and modify images that are not refined enough, and update them irregularly every week.
2-We are currently creating two new protagonist story flow DLCs, and in order to ensure the quality and richness of the content, we are expected to meet with everyone in mid April.
3-We are also working on the ending of the game to ensure that the entire story has a beginning and an end. The exact release time is yet to be determined.
4-In the near future, we will still listen to player feedback and try to fix any negative experiences in the game.
5-Thank you again for your support. Although our team size is limited and content updates may be relatively slow, we will still maintain our best spirit and continue to bring high-quality content to players.
6-We will update and add languages such as Korean, Thai, French, Portuguese, and Russian in the near future; For the convenience of players from various language regions to play; Due to the limited financial resources of the studio, Google Translate is used for translation. Therefore, it is recommended to use the existing four languages. We hope everyone can understand and support this.
